newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway T-bill expansion gets 3.43 pct high yield.
newsitem.headline: Norway T-bill expansion gets 3.43 pct high yield.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Wednesday that a 12 billion crown expansion of the SS42 treasury bill produced a highest yield of 3.43 percent.
The lowest yield at the ad hoc auction was 3.34 percent and the weighted average was 3.40 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 46 percent allotment.
The bill was issued on March 14 last year with a nominal interest rate of 4.70 percent. It matures on March 19.
The bank does not provide figures for the total amount of money issued in the bill, which was last expanded by 12 billion crowns on January 2.
